questions.stem: A processor executes 2 million instructions with a CPI of 3 and a clock rate of 1.5 GHz. Calculate the CPU time in milliseconds.
questions.explanation: First, convert the clock rate to clock cycle time: \( \text{Clock Cycle Time} = \frac{1}{1.5 \times 10^9} \) seconds. Then, calculate CPU time: \( \text{CPU Time} = 2 \times 10^6 \times 3 \times \frac{1}{1.5 \times 10^9} = 4 \times 10^{-3} \) seconds, which is 4 milliseconds.
